extra.q: What is the wifi password?

extra.q: Where is the summit taking place?
extra.answer: The HealthTech Summit 2026 takes place at the Harborview Convention Center in Boston [1].

extra.q: Where and when do I pick up my badge?
extra.answer: You can pick up your badge in the main lobby starting at 08:00 on November 24, and you must bring a photo ID.

extra.q: Is lunch provided, and when?
extra.answer: Yes, lunch is provided and is served from 12:00 to 13:00 in the exhibit hall each day [1].

extra.q: Are the sessions recorded?
extra.answer: Keynotes and main-hall talks are recorded and posted in the event app within 48 hours, and attendees get access to recorded sessions for 90 days. However, workshops are not recorded.

extra.q: Will the workshops be recorded?
extra.answer: No, workshops are not recorded.

extra.q: Is the venue wheelchair accessible?
extra.answer: Yes, all rooms at the venue are step-free and wheelchair loans are available by asking at the help desk [1].

extra.q: How can I connect with other attendees?
extra.answer: To connect with other attendees, turn on networking in your profile [1]. Only attendees who have opted in will appear in your matches, and contact details are shared only after a connection is accepted [1].

extra.q: Where is the attendee lounge?
extra.answer: The attendee lounge is located next to the main hall [1].

extra.q: Do I get a certificate of attendance?
extra.answer: Yes, attendees receive a certificate of attendance, which is emailed to checked-in participants within a week after the event [1, 2].

extra.q: How long can I watch recorded sessions after the event?
extra.answer: Attendees of HealthTech Summit 2026 get access to recorded sessions for 90 days [2].

extra.q: Where is first aid?
extra.answer: First aid is located next to the help desk.

extra.q: Can I take photos of other attendees?
extra.answer: Photography of other attendees requires their consent.

extra.q: How many sessions are there in total?
extra.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_sessions FROM session_attendance_v LIMIT 200

extra.q: How many workshops are on the program?
extra.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS workshops FROM session_attendance_v WHERE session_kind = 'workshop' LIMIT 200

extra.q: How many sessions of each kind (keynote, talk, panel, workshop) are there?
extra.sql: SELECT session_kind, COUNT(*) AS session_count FROM session_attendance_v GROUP BY session_kind ORDER BY session_count DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 200

extra.q: Which session has the most bookmarks?
extra.sql: SELECT title, bookmarks FROM session_attendance_v ORDER BY bookmarks DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

extra.q: List the top 5 sessions by number of bookmarks.
extra.sql: SELECT title, bookmarks FROM session_attendance_v ORDER BY bookmarks DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 5

extra.q: Which sessions are bookmarked beyond their room capacity?
extra.sql: SELECT title, bookmarks, capacity, bookmark_capacity_pct FROM session_attendance_v WHERE bookmark_capacity_pct > 100 ORDER BY bookmark_capacity_pct DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

extra.q: Which session had the highest drop-off after 20 minutes?
extra.sql: SELECT title, dropoff_after_20min_pct FROM session_attendance_v ORDER BY dropoff_after_20min_pct DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

extra.q: How many people checked in to the opening keynote?
extra.sql: SELECT checkins FROM session_attendance_v WHERE session_kind = 'keynote' ORDER BY starts_at ASC LIMIT 1

extra.q: Which track has the most sessions?
extra.sql: SELECT track, COUNT(*) AS sessions FROM session_attendance_v GROUP BY track ORDER BY sessions DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

extra.q: What is the total number of check-ins per track?
extra.sql: SELECT track, SUM(checkins) AS total_checkins FROM session_attendance_v GROUP BY track ORDER BY total_checkins DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 200

extra.q: Which rooms host workshops?
extra.sql: SELECT room, COUNT(*) AS workshop_count FROM session_attendance_v WHERE session_kind = 'workshop' GROUP BY room ORDER BY workshop_count DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

extra.q: Which exhibitor had the most booth visits?
extra.sql: SELECT exhibitor_name, booth_visits FROM exhibitor_performance_v ORDER BY booth_visits DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

extra.q: Who are the top 3 exhibitors by number of leads?
extra.sql: SELECT exhibitor_name, leads FROM exhibitor_performance_v ORDER BY leads DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 3

extra.q: Which exhibitor generated the most qualified leads yesterday?
extra.sql: SELECT exhibitor_name, qualified_leads FROM lead_summary_v WHERE lead_date = CURRENT_DATE - 1 ORDER BY qualified_leads DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

extra.q: How many leads did MedScan capture in total?
extra.sql: SELECT SUM(leads) AS total_leads FROM exhibitor_performance_v WHERE exhibitor_name = 'MedScan' LIMIT 200

extra.q: How many leads were captured on each day of the event?
extra.sql: SELECT lead_date AS day, SUM(leads) AS total_leads FROM lead_summary_v GROUP BY lead_date ORDER BY lead_date LIMIT 200

extra.q: Which exhibitor has the highest visitor-to-lead conversion rate?
extra.sql: SELECT exhibitor_name, visitor_to_lead_pct FROM exhibitor_performance_v ORDER BY visitor_to_lead_pct DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

extra.q: How many meeting requests did exhibitors receive in total?
extra.sql: SELECT SUM(meeting_requests) AS total_meeting_requests FROM exhibitor_performance_v LIMIT 200

extra.q: Which booth is MedScan at?
extra.sql: SELECT exhibitor_name, booth FROM exhibitor_performance_v WHERE exhibitor_name ILIKE '%MedScan%' LIMIT 200

extra.q: How many exhibitors are there in each category?
extra.sql: SELECT exhibitor_category, COUNT(exhibitor_id) AS exhibitors FROM exhibitor_performance_v GROUP BY exhibitor_category ORDER BY exhibitors DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 200

extra.q: How many app opens were there yesterday?
extra.sql: SELECT SUM(events) AS app_opens FROM engagement_v WHERE kind = 'app_open' AND day = CURRENT_DATE - 1 LIMIT 200

extra.q: On which day were there the most booth visits?
extra.sql: SELECT day, SUM(events) AS booth_visits FROM engagement_v WHERE kind = 'booth_visit' GROUP BY day ORDER BY booth_visits DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

extra.q: How many peer connection requests were accepted overall?
extra.sql: SELECT SUM(connections_accepted) AS accepted_connections FROM networking_v LIMIT 200

extra.q: How many attendees opted in to exhibitor matching?
extra.sql: SELECT SUM(exhibitor_matching_opt_in) AS opted_in FROM attendee_optin_v LIMIT 200

extra.q: Which attendee industry has the most attendees?
extra.sql: SELECT industry, attendees FROM attendee_optin_v ORDER BY attendees DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
